statement: SDL_gamepad_db.h at 535d80b has a Linux GUID mapping entry for Microsoft 045e:028e (030000005e0400008e02000010010000) defining A/B, shoulders, D-pad hat, trigger axes and sticks for evdev-style joystick; other platform variants exist. This maps recognized controls; it does not prove HIDAPI XUSB attachment or physical controller identity.
